build_dm21_rks_calculation: build a PySCF RKS calculation using NeuralNumInt with the DM21 functional for ground state DFT
build_dm21_uks_calculation: build a PySCF UKS calculation using NeuralNumInt with the DM21m functional for spin-polarized systems
export_functional_and_derivatives: export the DM21 functional TensorFlow graph with derivatives to a path for C++ or tfcompile use
construct_functional_inputs: construct the FunctionalInputs features including density and local Hartree-Fock terms for the DM21 functional
eval_xc_energy_and_derivatives: evaluate the XC energy and first-order functional derivatives on the grid using the DM21 neural functional
